m01_count_not_shape.what: the shared predicate compares batch COUNTS at equal ranks, not shapes
m01_count_not_shape.named_assertion: pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match='^matmul refused: .*batch.*(A [2, 3, 2, 3] on ..., B [3, 2, 3, 4] on ...') -- the mutant accepts the equal-count pair, so the call reaches the GEMM and raises the no-device CUDA error instead (regex does not match)

m02_no_device_check.what: the forward's predicate drops the device check
m02_no_device_check.old:
if (a.device.type != b.device.type || a.device.index != b.device.index)
    return refuse(p, MatmulOperandIssue::Device, "operands are on different devices", a, b, trans_b);
m02_no_device_check.named_assertion: pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match='^matmul refused: operands are on different devices (A ... on <dev>, B ... on <dev>') -- CPU: the zero-element CUDA operand lets the call reach the output allocation / GEMM (CUDA error); GPU line: nonzero host + CUDA operands reach cuBLAS (any outcome other than the refusal fails the regex or 'DID NOT RAISE')
m02_no_device_check.order_source: G5 m02 (G1, mixed host and CUDA operands, staged GPU line)
m02_no_device_check.run: CPU witness + staged GPU line mut_m02

m03_no_intmax.what: the forward's predicate drops the INT_MAX checks (M, N, K and the batch count)
m03_no_intmax.named_assertion: pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match='^matmul refused: GEMM (dimension|batch count) above INT_MAX.*(A ..., B ...') -- the mutant lets the call reach the GEMM (no-device CUDA error)
